parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 disable.explanation: 禁用接口。Juniper默认接口是禁用的，这行用来启用接口。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 设备的自治系统号，用于BGP等路由协议。

set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.1.1.2 peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group EBGP neighbor 10.explanation: 配置BGP邻居及其自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group EBGP type extern.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP type external

set protocols bgp group EBGP family inet.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group EBGP family inet.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPO.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPORT-ROUTES
set protocols bgp group EBGP export EXPO.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的导出策略。

set protocols bgp group EBGP import ACCE.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP import ACCEPT-ROUTES
set protocols bgp group EBGP import ACCE.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的导入策略。

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3]/[parameter4] [parameter5]
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-ROUTES term 1 from route-filter 10.1.1.0/24 exact
set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件。

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: 路由过滤器，用于匹配特定的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement EXPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT-ROUTES term 1 then accept

set policy-options policy-statement ACCE.command: set policy-options policy-statement ACCEPT-ROUTES then accept
set policy-options policy-statement ACCE.explanation: 配置策略语句的默认动作。
